subject: POC kickoff / hands-on working session - scheduling and agenda
messages:
From: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff - proposed dates

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team found the latency/cost tradeoffs interesting and we'd like to kick off a short POC. We'd like a hands-on working session to cover:
- prompt review and prompt engineering best practices
- routing & fallbacks across model variants
- small-scale load tests (QPS/latency targets)

Can we set aside ~2 hours next week for a joint kickoff + hands-on session where your SEs can help us run some prompts and a few throughput tests? Our initial availability: Mon Jun 16 (10am-12pm PT) or Tue Jun 17 (9am-11am PT).

Attendees from Acme: myself (eng lead), Karen Li (product), two SREs (names to follow). We'll need the Redwood team to bring a test environment and a short pre-read so our product folks can prep.

Thanks,
John
John Doe
Senior Engineering Manager, Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff - proposed dates

Hi John — great to hear! Happy to get this scheduled.

Jun 16 is a bit tight for our SEs, but we can do Mon Jun 16 11:00am-1:00pm PT or Tue Jun 17 11:00am-1:00pm PT. If neither works, we can also do Wed Jun 18 9:00am-11:00am PT.

Proposed 2-hr agenda (high level):
1) 15m introductions & objectives (your success criteria)
2) 30m prompt review & example prompts (prompt engineering best practices)
3) 45m hands-on: run prompts on your sample dataset + routing demo
4) 20m small-scale load tests (QPS targets, observe latency)
5) 10m next steps & action items

Can you confirm preferred date/time and whether your SREs want to run the load tests or have our infra team run them? Looping in Ben Carter (solutions engineer) to own the hands-on session.

I'll prepare a short pre-read (agenda + prompt checklist + access instructions) once we lock time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff - proposed dates / agenda details

Hi John,

Quick note on the hands-on agenda from the SE side:
- For prompt review: please share 8-10 representative prompts (one-liners + expected outputs). We will validate prompt templates and suggest canonicalizations.
- For routing: we'll demo policy-based routing (latency vs cost) and a fallback plan — will need a couple of sample model variants to test against.
- For load tests: please provide a target QPS and sample prompt set (we can run a ramp test up to your target; typical ramp: 1 -> 10 -> 50 QPS).

I'll prepare: slides (overview + brief blueprint), a checklist (pre-reqs: API keys, sample payloads, test dataset), and a short runbook for the load tests. Priyom (cc) will own infra and load test execution.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff - proposed dates

Hi Marissa, John — thanks. A few folks on our side are out on Mon/Tue, so Wed Jun 18 9:00am-11:00am PT works best for us. Can you lock that slot? Also please share the pre-read and any access instructions for the test environment.

Attendees confirmed: John Doe (eng lead), Karen Li (product), Mike Chen (SRE), Ana Gomez (SRE), Priya Patel (PM).

We'd prefer the Redwood team to run the initial load tests while our SREs observe — they can take over after if needed.

Thanks,
Karen Li
